name: Salyut-7
about: Salyut-7 (1982-033A), a station core, launched 1982 Apr 19. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (R).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1982 May 19), held fixed
